reading.title: The Pizza Shop 1: A short reading
reading.text: Maya and Omar order a pizza to share. Maya wants a veggie pizza with pepper and onion. Omar prefers pepperoni, but they agree on margherita with extra mozzarella. They also discuss Hawaiian and four cheese. The worker repeats their order before preparing it, so both customers know which pizza they will receive.
